candidateRule: A Study may compile an owner-native scientific ClaimPermission only after it owns exact claims whose current scientific meaning and ceiling can be bound to frozen evidence and inference authority. Pre-outcome protocols, statistical plans, screening rules, or future claim ceilings do not themselves constitute ClaimPermission.
nonClaims: Paper2 immaturity for ClaimPermission is not scientific weakness and does not invalidate its prospectively frozen protocol.
A frozen future claim ceiling is not a permission to assert an outcome-bearing claim before outcome, eligibility, and synthesis authority closes.
This two-Study pressure does not admit a shared executable ClaimPermission compiler or universal maturity ontology.
